xyy.card.wq01.name: 无尘剑
xyy.card.wq01.rule: while the enabled weapon is equipped, base battle strength plus one and hit plus one

xyy.card.wq02.name: 天蛇杖
xyy.card.wq02.rule: while enabled, base battle strength plus one and each positive non-TERMIN_AT cure to the owner gains one HP
xyy.card.wq02.verifiedBoundary: equip/replacement plus deterministic positive non-TERMIN_AT owner-cure increase across TP02 normal, TP02 rescue and JP03 team healing

xyy.card.wq03.name: 魔刀天叱
xyy.card.wq03.rule: while the enabled weapon is equipped, base battle strength plus two

xyy.card.wq04.name: 魔剑
xyy.card.wq04.rule: while enabled hit plus one; during the owner's technique phase the physical card may be pawned from hand or weapon slot to draw two without a response window
xyy.card.wq04.verifiedBoundary: equip/replacement plus hand-or-equipped pawn draw-two, replay, restart and six-socket isolation

xyy.card.wq05.name: 彩环
xyy.card.wq05.rule: while the enabled weapon is equipped, hit plus two

xyy.card.fj01.name: 五彩霞衣
xyy.card.fj01.rule: while enabled base battle strength plus one; when the alive owner is at zero HP, the owner may discard this armor to revive and cure two, then dying detection resumes
xyy.card.fj01.verifiedBoundary: equip/replacement plus owner-only zero-HP discard rescue, deterministic cure, dying-batch resume, replay and six-socket persistence

xyy.card.fj02.name: 天帝祭服
xyy.card.fj02.rule: while enabled, the owner may pay any own hand card as TP03 whenever TP03 is legal; the converted card uses the normal TP03 Bingxin chain

xyy.card.fj03.name: 龙魂战铠
xyy.card.fj03.rule: while enabled, reduce every positive owner damage item by one unless TERMIN_AT or DECR_INVAO, removing items reduced to zero
xyy.card.fj03.verifiedBoundary: equip/replacement plus per-item positive damage reduction, TERMIN_AT/DECR_INVAO bypass, zero-item removal, replay and six-socket persistence

xyy.card.fj04.name: 乾坤道袍
xyy.card.fj04.rule: while enabled base battle strength plus one and remove positive technique-card damage to the owner unless IMMUNE_INVAO
xyy.card.fj04.verifiedBoundary: equip/replacement plus FROM_JP damage removal with IMMUNE_INVAO bypass, replay and six-socket persistence

xyy.card.fj05.name: 踏云靴
xyy.card.fj05.rule: while enabled hit plus one; on owner damage the owner may discard this armor, remove every positive owner item unless DECR_INVAO or IMMUNE_INVAO (including TP03-immune damage), and cure one
xyy.card.fj05.verifiedBoundary: equip/replacement plus owner-only damage-window discard, DECR_INVAO/IMMUNE_INVAO bypass, TUX_INAVO prevention, deterministic cure, replay and six-socket persistence

decisions.healingPipeline: all cure entry points create deterministic serializable cure items before HP mutation
decisions.wq02ModifierScope: each positive non-TERMIN_AT cure item targeting the enabled owner gains exactly one regardless of cure source
decisions.damageMaskRepresentation: canonical ordered arrays preserve combinable legacy flags in JSON events
decisions.passiveDamageOrder: equipment reduction or immunity is included in the deterministic damage plan before the TP03 response gate and HP mutation
